[[File:TEGtD_SM_scavenger_droid.png|thumb|right|250px|A pair of SM series scavenger droids at work]]
{{Quote|Blast! I really hate those scavs!|[[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Republic Commando">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>}}
'''Salvage droids''' or '''scavenger droids''', often called '''scavs''' and alternatively known as '''retrieval droids''', were small automated [[Droid/Legends|droids]], generally operating in gangs, which were deployed at accident sites to [[Scavenger|scavenge]] for usable parts.

==History==
The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] employed a large number of these droids to search through the remains of their [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] after battles, to seek out any parts which could be used again in new droids, therefore cutting costs. They were also used by salvagers to aid their exploits.

[[File:Scavdroid.jpg|right|thumb||150px|A scavenger droid on board the ''[[Prosecutor]]'']]
Another variant, used by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] mercenaries and slavers, was built to attach to a clone trooper's helmet, drill through the visor, eliminate the trooper, and then carry them away. This type was also equipped with a beam weapon capable of draining the personal shields used by clone commandos. Their programming included a suicide ramming attack in case of sustaining significant damage. They could also attach themselves to walls and cut through cables, waiting silently for their prey and then attacking. Afterwards, the droids would pick up the bodies and carry them to dump sites.
